statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The service is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry (CPT 93229)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
The service is medically necessary to detect intermittent arrhythmias that may contribute to hemodynamic instability or embolic risk
